text: きみ　ポケモン　つよいけど　りかは　とくい　なのかい？

structure.jp: ポケモン　つよいけど
りかは　とくい　なのかい？

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts of a sentence with the meaning 'but'. つよいけど = 'you're strong, but'.

patterns.name: 〜かい
patterns.explanation: かい is a softer, friendly か for yes-or-no questions, used mostly by men; なの before it adds the feeling of wanting to know. とくい　なのかい = 'are you good at it?'.
